correctness.rationale: The full three-row recurrence reduces exactly to p_i=x_{t,i-1} OR x_{t,i+1}. Any p_i=0 forces complete zero columns at neighbors, and propagates; otherwise p_i=1 gives the four odd temporal columns. All three OR equations hold if and only if no two one-hot columns are separated by two spatial sites. Both directions and the injective row-pair reconstruction are proved. The step-two graph is C_n on odd n or two C_{n/2} on even n; the independent-set trace yields the closed polynomial. Two independent executable checks fully match their finite domains.
